title: Grapher election tile-cartogram layout (frontend-owned)
description: Persisted tile-cartogram (equal-area hex) layouts for election constituencies, owned by the frontend per ADR-0045. One row per (layout_kind, scope, delim_year, unit_id) tile. Coordinates are pre-computed and PERSISTED so citizens see stable seat positions (no browser-side layout compute). Grain-agnostic: serves AC (state assembly) and PC (Lok Sabha) cartograms from the same contract. Derived from boundary centroids via a one-time hexbin pass (derivation_method=centroid-hexbin) or hand-authored cleanup (derivation_method=hand-authored).

x-changelog.description: Initial election tile-cartogram layout schema (UK-style elections experience plan, PR-B1). Carries axial hex coords (q, r) plus optional pixel coords (x, y), the canonical unit_id (ac_id/pc_id) for direct join to winner observations, eci_no, citizen label, source provenance, and derivation_method. Seeds the Maharashtra (S13) AC layout and the national PC layout.

layout_kind.description: Constituency grain: 'ac' = state assembly, 'pc' = Lok Sabha parliamentary.

scope.description: Cartogram scope: a state/UT code (e.g. 'S13') for AC layouts, or 'national' for the all-India PC layout.

delim_year.description: Delimitation vintage the constituency boundaries belong to (e.g. 2008).

unit_id.description: Canonical entity id of the constituency (ac_id 'IN-<state>-AC-<delim>-<eci_no>' or pc_id 'IN-PC-<delim>-<state>-<pc_no>'). Joins directly to the winner observation's entity_id.

eci_no.description: ECI numeric seat code within the scope (ac_no for AC, ls_seat_code for PC).

q.description: Axial hex column coordinate (pointy-top axial grid).

r.description: Axial hex row coordinate (pointy-top axial grid).

x.description: Optional pre-computed pixel/world x (else derive from q,r at render).

y.description: Optional pre-computed pixel/world y (else derive from q,r at render).

label.description: Citizen-readable constituency name for the tile tooltip/label.

source_id.description: Geometry provenance the centroid was derived from (boundary dataset path or source id).

layout_version.description: Optional per-layout version tag for hand-authored revisions.

derivation_method.description: How the q,r coords were produced: automatic centroid-hexbin pass or hand-authored cleanup.
